##### About

Darkhan Islam is a graduate student in the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master’s programme in Imaging, currently studying at Tampere University in Finland, following his first year at Politecnico di Milano in Italy.

With a background in Applied Mathematics and Computer Science, he is interested in machine learning, computer vision, and data-driven approaches to solving real-world problems.

His experience spans data analytics, recommender systems, and medical imaging research. He previously worked at Kaspi.kz, contributing to the development and optimization of recommendation systems, and at Fondazione IRCCS Istituto Nazionale dei Tumori di Milano, where he worked on medical imaging and predictive modeling.

He enjoys working at the intersection of mathematics, software engineering, and machine learning, particularly on problems that require both analytical thinking and practical implementation.

Bachelor's degree in Applied Mathematics. Diploma project: a mobile application for OCR-based text recognition and AI-generated text detection.
